name: BSDF Sampling for Volumetric Paths
aliases: Implicit Path Tracing with Volume Interaction
Ray Tracing in One Weekend Go Implementation
Surface scattering in volumetric path tracing
definition: Samples BSDF at surface intersections to determine new volumetric path direction, updating throughput and rescaled probabilities.
summary: BSDF Sampling for Volumetric Paths handles surface interactions in participating media by calculating indirect lighting and redirecting rays back into the medium, bridging surface geometry and volume scattering.
